title: FastThaiG2P: Lightning-fast Thai Grapheme-to-phoneme Conversion for Voice Agent Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2608.12814v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: FastThaiG2P provides sub-millisecond Thai grapheme-to-phoneme conversion for text-to-speech pipelines (International Phonetic Alphabet and Kokoro-TTS conventions) using a PyThaiNLP-tokenized, extensible dictionary and normalization rules for common Central Thai speech. The approach achieves an average latency of 0.15 ms per utterance on a benchmark of 27,242 synthetically generated utterances, of which 30\% is spent on tokenization, 12\% on normalization, and 58\% on out-of-vocabulary fallbacks (0.5\% OOV rate). To demonstrate its effectiveness, we used FastThaiG2P to phonemize Som-TTS, an open dataset containing 20 hours of grapheme-and-audio pairs, then trained an 82M-parameter StyleTTS 2 model based on a Kokoro-TTS recipe. The resulting model vocalizes intelligible Thai speech suitable for prototyping and development at 0.25 real-time factor (4x real-time) with ONNX inference on CPU.

translated_title: FastThaiG2P：面向语音代理管线的闪电般快速的泰语字素到音素转换
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12814v1 公告类型：新 摘要：FastThaiG2P为文本转语音管线（国际音标和Kokoro-TTS约定）提供亚毫秒级的泰语字素到音素转换，使用PyThaiNLP分词、可扩展词典和针对常见中部泰语语音的规范化规则。该方法在27,242条合成语音的基准测试中实现了每条话语平均0.15毫秒的延迟，其中30%的时间用于分词，12%用于规范化，58%用于词汇外回退（词汇外率为0.5%）。为了展示其有效性，我们使用FastThaiG2P对Som-TTS进行了音素化处理，该开放数据集包含20小时的文字-音频对，然后基于Kokoro-TTS配方训练了一个8200万参数的StyleTTS 2模型。该模型在CPU上进行ONNX推理时，以0.25实时因子（4倍实时）生成可理解的泰语语音，适用于原型开发。
tldr: FastThaiG2P通过优化的分词和规范化流程，实现了泰语字素到音素的亚毫秒级转换，显著降低了文本转语音管线的延迟，并成功应用于训练高效的泰语语音合成模型。
en_tdlr: FastThaiG2P achieves sub-millisecond Thai grapheme-to-phoneme conversion with optimized tokenization and normalization, significantly reducing latency in TTS pipelines and enabling efficient Thai speech synthesis model training.
